data.one_liner: Flutter UI extensions, providers, and bindings for the bloc_signals state management library.
data.what_it_does: Provides Flutter widgets like BlocSignalBuilder, BlocSignalListener, and BlocSignalConsumer, dependency injection via BlocSignalProvider, and BuildContext extensions to bridge the bloc_signals state management library into Flutter applications.
use_when: You are using the bloc_signals state management library in a Flutter application.
You need fine-grained reactive builders, side-effect listeners, and selectors for state containers.
You require dependency injection and lifecycle management for state containers via InheritedWidget.
avoid_when: You are using standard BLoC/Cubit without signals (use flutter_bloc instead).
You are building a pure Dart application without Flutter.
strengths: Synchronous and fine-grained reactive updates using signals.
Comprehensive suite of provider, builder, listener, and consumer widgets.
Seamless interop with Flutter Listenable and ValueListenable.
weaknesses: Tied directly to the bloc_signals ecosystem.
Requires learning the conventions of both BLoC and Signals.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the traditional BLoC and Cubit pattern without the signals library backend.

alternatives.name: flutter_riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a compile-safe, provider-first state management architecture.
